{{Top|leg}}
'''Division Three Field Agents''' were [[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] assigned to the [[Imperial Taxation Bureau]]'s [[Division Three]]. Field Agents were armed with [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistols]] and [[Knife/Legends|knives]], and carried a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] and [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]]. They were also assisted in the duties by a [[Military protocol droid/Legends|military protocol droid]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
